title: Windproof and Ready  (A prueba de viento y listos)

segments.t: La mañana del sábado avanza luminosa y con brisa en el Patio de los Tilos. A las doce menos cinco, Hannah, Tessa y Caleb contemplan desde debajo del árbol veinticuatro farolillos coral y dorados que se mecen, firmes, desde el balcón hasta las ramas. Presta atención a la escena completa.
Look up at those four lines from the balcony — not one lantern twisted overnight!
And look down at the tables: twenty-eight linen napkins clipped tight with numbered birch pins!
Even Graham clipped four extra clothespins to the corners of every white tablecloth!
At three this afternoon I bake four berry almond cakes so they are warm by six.
And at four this afternoon Evelyn and I finish rehearsing our four hand piano duet!
Everything is timed to the minute: afternoon prep, five thirty tea, six sharp arrival!
Knock on wood right now, Hannah — never say everything is timed to the minute!
What could possibly change at noon? Our guest wrote six this evening in black ink!
Wait — do you two hear the front desk telephone ringing through the lobby window?
That is a very loud, very urgent Saturday noon ring, Hannah!
Even Graham just looked up from his paper ledger behind the glass door!
Hold my apron — I had better answer that call before twelve chimes finish!
Antes de que ese teléfono vuelva a sonar, recorramos la escena paso a paso.
Look up at those four lines from the balcony — not one lantern twisted overnight!
'Miren esas cuatro cuerdas que bajan del balcón: ¡ni un solo farolillo se enredó durante la noche!'
And look down at the tables: twenty-eight linen napkins clipped tight with numbered birch pins!
'Y miren abajo, a las mesas: ¡veintiocho servilletas de lino bien sujetas con pinzas de abedul numeradas!'
Even Graham clipped four extra clothespins to the corners of every white tablecloth!
'¡Hasta Graham sujetó cuatro pinzas más en las esquinas de cada mantel blanco!'
At three this afternoon I bake four berry almond cakes so they are warm by six.
'A las tres de esta tarde horneo cuatro pasteles de frutos rojos y almendra para que estén calentitos a las seis.'
And at four this afternoon Evelyn and I finish rehearsing our four hand piano duet!
'¡Y a las cuatro de esta tarde Evelyn y yo terminamos de ensayar nuestro dúo de piano a cuatro manos!'
Everything is timed to the minute: afternoon prep, five thirty tea, six sharp arrival!
'Todo está calculado al minuto: preparativos por la tarde, té a las cinco y media, ¡llegada a las seis en punto!'
Knock on wood right now, Hannah — never say everything is timed to the minute!
'Toca madera ahora mismo, Hannah: ¡nunca digas que todo está calculado al minuto!'
What could possibly change at noon? Our guest wrote six this evening in black ink!
'¿Qué podría cambiar al mediodía? ¡Nuestro invitado escribió «las seis de esta tarde» con tinta negra!'
Wait — do you two hear the front desk telephone ringing through the lobby window?
'Esperen, ¿ustedes dos oyen el teléfono de recepción sonando a través de la ventana del vestíbulo?'
That is a very loud, very urgent Saturday noon ring, Hannah!
'¡Ese es un timbrazo de sábado al mediodía muy fuerte y muy urgente, Hannah!'
Even Graham just looked up from his paper ledger behind the glass door!
'¡Hasta Graham acaba de levantar la vista de su libro de cuentas, detrás de la puerta de cristal!'
Hold my apron — I had better answer that call before twelve chimes finish!
'Sujétame el delantal: ¡más vale que conteste esa llamada antes de que terminen las doce campanadas!'
Y ahora, la escena de corrido, tal como la viven nuestros personajes.
Look up at those four lines from the balcony — not one lantern twisted overnight!
And look down at the tables: twenty-eight linen napkins clipped tight with numbered birch pins!
Even Graham clipped four extra clothespins to the corners of every white tablecloth!
At three this afternoon I bake four berry almond cakes so they are warm by six.
And at four this afternoon Evelyn and I finish rehearsing our four hand piano duet!
Everything is timed to the minute: afternoon prep, five thirty tea, six sharp arrival!
Knock on wood right now, Hannah — never say everything is timed to the minute!
What could possibly change at noon? Our guest wrote six this evening in black ink!
Wait — do you two hear the front desk telephone ringing through the lobby window?
That is a very loud, very urgent Saturday noon ring, Hannah!
Even Graham just looked up from his paper ledger behind the glass door!
Hold my apron — I had better answer that call before twelve chimes finish!
Todo está listo para las seis de la tarde... hasta que una llamada al mediodía pone patas arriba los planes del sábado. Así termina el episodio cuatro: ¡te esperamos en el episodio cinco!
See you next time!
